verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS accounting product like FreshBooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, storage regions, or any choice of where data is hosted. The available items cover invoicing, payments, the API, webhooks, auth, and pricing, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
